modules.behavior: Parameterized synchronous elastic packet-tagged FIFO, public parameters WIDTH=8 and DEPTH=3 in that order. Supported experiment domain: integer WIDTH 1..16 and DEPTH 1..8. Input/output data ports must remain symbolic [WIDTH-1:0]; last ports remain one bit. DEPTH controls actual capacity, pointer wrap and occupancy. Preserve all supported parameter behavior, not only defaults. At rising clk, synchronous active-high rst discards all queued tuples and overrides transfers; reset has no effect between edges. Otherwise accept the atomic tuple (in_data,in_last) on in_valid && in_ready and retire (out_data,out_last) on out_valid && out_ready sampled before the edge. out_valid equals (occupancy != 0), in_ready equals (occupancy < DEPTH) || out_ready. This is a combinational ready path; full simultaneous pop/push is legal and must preserve occupancy. While valid, out_data and out_last are exactly the oldest unretired accepted tuple, preserving order, multiplicity, every data bit and every last bit together. Keep out_valid, out_data and out_last stable under output stall until transfer or reset. Invalid out_data and out_last are unspecified. Last is an ordinary payload marker, not a handshake or a store-and-forward condition: present queued beats without waiting for a last-marked beat, allow zero or consecutive last markers, and never invent or infer a marker from the data. Reset may discard a partial packet without manufacturing a last-marked output. No empty bypass: a new tuple captured into an empty queue becomes valid only after capture, with earliest output transfer at the following edge (minimum age 1). Sustain one push and pop per cycle when nonempty and downstream ready. Explicitly wrap at DEPTH-1; do not assume power-of-two depth or truncate data to eight bits. For Python scoreboard oracle ONLY, each non-reset step represents one accepted input transaction: return its eventual identical out_data masked to default WIDTH and out_last masked to one bit. The oracle does not simulate occupancy, ready/valid scheduling, stalls or a delay queue; RTL must still implement all temporal behavior above. init() represents reset state and supplied rst must be handled. The independent temporal testbench checks the default wrapper and additional child parameter configurations.

module packet_fifo (

    input wire [7:0] in_data,
    input wire in_last,
    input wire in_valid,
    output wire in_ready,
    output wire [7:0] out_data,
    output wire out_last,
    output wire out_valid,
    input wire out_ready
);
    packet_fifo_core #( .WIDTH(8), .DEPTH(3) ) u_packet_fifo_core (
        .clk(clk),
        .rst(rst),
        .in_data(in_data),
        .in_last(in_last),
        .in_valid(in_valid),
        .in_ready(in_ready),
        .out_data(out_data),
        .out_last(out_last),
        .out_valid(out_valid),
        .out_ready(out_ready)
    );
endmodule
